schema.name: shell_command
schema.description:
Runs a shell command and returns its output.
- Always set the `workdir` param when using the shell_command function. Do not use `cd` unless absolutely necessary. For doing file changes, use the apply_patch
- Set `timeout_ms` to kill the command after the given wall-clock duration; omit it to let the command run without a timeout

workdir.description: Optional working directory to run the command in; defaults to the turn cwd.

timeout_ms.description: The timeout for the command in milliseconds
